structure.common: Shared strings used across multiple tools (privacy note, no signup text, offline ready, etc.)

[tool_id].what_is_title: Heading for What Is section (keep under 60 chars)
[tool_id].what_is_content: Full explanation text (can contain line breaks \n and HTML tags)
[tool_id].how_to_use_title: Heading for How to Use section
[tool_id].common_use_cases_title: Heading for Common Use Cases section
[tool_id].privacy_note: Privacy and trust disclaimer note text

schema_org.name: Tool name for Schema.org JSON-LD
schema_org.description: Tool short description for Schema.org JSON-LD

translation_rules.page_title: Keep under 60 characters for SEO; preserve brand name 99tool.in.
translation_rules.meta_description: Keep under 160 characters; maintain natural phrasing in target language.
translation_rules.what_is_content: Preserve all HTML markup (<strong>, <code>, <a>) exactly; keep tone professional and helpful.
translation_rules.how_to_use_steps: Keep steps ordered and clear; translate lead action words accurately inside <strong> tags.
translation_rules.key_features: Preserve feature titles in <strong> tags; ensure concise technical terminology.
translation_rules.common_use_cases: Translate scenarios into natural context for target region/language.
translation_rules.faq: Translate both questions and answers naturally (do not literally word-swap); preserve technical code samples verbatim.
translation_rules.privacy_note: Maintain strict security/privacy accuracy; do not alter legal guarantees.
translation_rules.schema_org: Translate name and description while ensuring JSON-LD compliance.
